INTERPRETATION PARAMETERS WITH REFERENCE
-----------------------------------------

MUAP Amplitude                    200 µV – 2 mV
Polyphasic MUAPs                  <15% in a normal muscle

IMPRESSION
-----------------------------------------
[ ] Normal EMG study – No evidence of neuromuscular disorder
[ ] Findings suggestive of neurogenic pattern
[ ] Findings suggestive of myopathic pattern
[ ] Correlate with NCS and clinical findings

COMMENTS
-----------------------------------------
- EMG findings should be interpreted along with nerve conduction studies (NCS) and clinical history.
- Repeat study if symptoms progress.
